notes: Content lives under #app > div.app-root. Main content grid (div.aem-Grid--12) contains 17 AEM components in document order. Header (header.s1-header) and footer (footer.s3-secondary-footer) are auto-populated and excluded. The color wizard, product carousel widget, and social logo-group are JS-rendered interactive widgets with little static markup.

existingCustomVariants.cards-insights: image + type label + category tags + title (articles grid)

blockInventory.note: Existing custom variants originate from a prior NGS Super (finance) migration. Domain semantics differ from Dulux (paint), so most are not reused; the generic structural shapes (cards grid, hero banner, image feature) still guide new variant creation.
